description: Entity Framework Core migration file that modifies the schema of the 'Orders' table to enforce non-null constraints and default values on 'ShipToAddress' fields.

classes.name: FixShipToAddress
classes.description: A Migration class that updates the database schema for the 'ShipToAddress' fields in the 'Orders' table.

methods.name: Up
methods.description: Defines the schema changes to apply: sets 'ShipToAddress' fields to non-nullable and provides default values.

methods.name: Down
methods.description: Reverts the schema changes made in the Up method, restoring nullable settings and removing default values.
